source_policy: 19 primary human research sources and 1 official anatomical resource; no tertiary wellness or art claims used as anatomical proof.
editorial_rules: Do not infer activation, tissue composition, health, stiffness or attractiveness from a silhouette.
Keep hip angle, knee angle, pelvis orientation, camera and contact conditions explicit.
An imposed indentation depth is not a measured applied force or a calibrated stiffness.
Do not present compact/full form descriptors as biological categories or age indicators.
Primary-source findings from male volunteers, elderly cadavers, surgical samples or small cohorts retain those limits.
Do not infer that muscles explain most between-person glute silhouette variance.
Abdominal internal arrangement does not uniquely determine external shape; separate evidence from an artistic surface interpretation.
access_note: Primary abstracts and available full texts are distinguished per entry. Some direct Blender manual opens returned 402; indexed official text and actual installed alpha execution were used. No access restriction was bypassed.
